rules.forward: read only against peers whose expected 3 px disc coverage min(1, 29 * footprint_density) is <= 0.70
rules.reverse: read only against peers with >= 30 dots
rules.operative: byte identity + full-footprint Spearman + exact dot-set Jaccard + mutual 3 px coincidence (min of both directions, limit 0.70); every literal firing is listed

informative_forward.reading: candidate duplicated into a peer that cannot cover it

informative_reverse.reading: a peer with >= 30 dots duplicated into the candidate

mutual.reading: THE operative directional test: a near-copy must coincide in both directions

uninformative_forward_saturating_or_dens.reading: dense/regular peers whose discs already blanket the footprint: every non-empty candidate overlaps forward (IR-57-REPR-01)

uninformative_reverse_tiny_peers.reading: peers with < 30 dots: the fraction is 0 or 1 by luck

representation_aware.note: Operative registry leg = symmetric, scale-free statistics (worst |Spearman rho| 0.0636 <= 0.90; worst exact dot-set Jaccard 0.0209 <= 0.50; 0 byte-identical peers) PLUS the mutual 3 px coincidence (worst mutual 0.4086 <= 0.70, 0 firings). 80 literal one-sided leg firings are preserved in 'literal_leg_firings' with peer name, support and expected coverage; they lie in the two documented uninformative directions (IR-57-REPR-01).

literal_leg_firing_summary.note: counted against the literal rule as stated (Spearman > 0.90 or > 70 % of either side's dots within 3 px); retained for audit and superseded by 'representation_aware' for the ship/don't-ship reading (IR-57-REPR-01)
